name: Shimmer Ridge
summary: In northern Dun Morogh, Shimmer Ridge lies west of the Gates of Ironforge, where Frostmane trolls hold two camps across a chasm. Shimmerweed grows nowhere else.

sections.title: A Frostmane Stronghold
sections.body: Frostmane trolls hold camps on both sides of a chasm, joined by a rickety wooden bridge. Troll scavengers and tamed mountain boars guard the rocky heights. The ridge lies near the main road and the dwarven capital, giving the trolls a place to raid travelers and mountain patrols.

sections.title: The Price of Shimmerweed
sections.body: Frostmane trolls grow shimmerweed on the ridge. Dwarven brewmasters prize the plant for the potent, flavorful highland ales it makes. Since it is hard to gather elsewhere, mountaineers and young recruits brave troll ambushes and tusked beasts to harvest it from the trolls' plots.

faq.answer: Shimmer Ridge lies in northern Dun Morogh, west of the Gates of Ironforge, which lead into the dwarven capital.
Frostmane trolls control Shimmer Ridge. They guard two camps joined by a bridge, with tamed mountain boars.

faq.q: What is shimmerweed and why is it sought after?
faq.answer: Shimmerweed is a mountain herb that grows on Shimmer Ridge. Local dwarven brewers value it for flavorful highland ale.

faq.q: Why don't the dwarves clear out the trolls completely?
faq.answer: Ironforge's military is occupied with broader defense and external matters. Regional mountaineers and wandering recruits handle local threats like the Frostmane camps in Dun Morogh.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can see the Frostmane threat from Ironforge's gates. Shimmer Ridge is a dangerous source of shimmerweed for dwarven stout.
As an herbalist, you can gather shimmerweed on Shimmer Ridge, where Frostmane trolls tend it among their camps.
